name: Nooks
description: Connect Nooks to Claude to analyze your outbound data in plain language. Search across prospects, sequences, tasks, and calls to surface insights, investigate performance, and answer questions about your pipeline.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nooks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nooks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nooks.in/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nooks?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Nooks in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Nooks requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nooks is developed by Nooks. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
